review_scope: historical comparison figure v1 only; not final manuscript audit

visual_review.median_marker_occlusion: 12 median markers are crossed by median bars because median zorder=5 exceeds scatter zorder=4; visible in PNG and PDF
visual_review.recommendation: Set median hlines zorder to 3, below scatter zorder 4; keep all values, symbols, annotation and caption unchanged.

limits: This checks extraction, aggregation, source-byte binding and figure presentation. It does not retrain or recompute model predictions.
Only the selected 36 source JSON and 54 associated weight files were byte checked in this followup, rather than all 398 historical files.
Historical full exit-code and warning-source binding gaps remain as stated in the prior historical execution-scope review.
The figure is a 36-run default-Adam-route subset with shared L-BFGS budgets; it is not an Adam-only experiment.
Three seeds do not establish statistical significance, cross-initial-value generalization, or universal superiority; strong baselines and negative controls remain in the manuscript.

findings.title: Median bars partially obscure seed markers
findings.observed: The black median line with zorder 5 crosses the median seed marker in all 12 groups; scatter markers have zorder 4. Visible in PNG and PDF.
findings.fix: Change only median hlines zorder from 5 to 3; preserve the scatter zorder 4, underlying data, caption and negative-case annotation.
